title: isvarname
summary: Return true when text is a valid MATLAB variable name.
description: `isvarname(S)` returns a logical scalar indicating whether text is a valid MATLAB variable name: nonempty, starts with a letter, is at most `namelengthmax` characters, contains only letters, digits, and underscores after the first character, and is not a MATLAB keyword.
behaviors: Returns a normal logical value and does not mutate inputs.
Accepts MATLAB text representations supported by RunMat.
Rejects names that start with underscores or digits, MATLAB keywords such as `for` and `end`, and names longer than `namelengthmax` characters.
